name: PayOnce check_payee
description: Verification of Payee for AI agents on Concordium. Before an agent pays, ask who the account really is: MATCH (pay once), CLOSE_MATCH (a person decides), NO_MATCH (pay nothing) or UNVERIFIED (verification not possible: a person decides). Reads any x402 seller's payTo for free. Free to call: REST, hosted MCP, `npx payonce-check-payee`, `npx payonce-mcp`, and a GitHub Action. The chain does not verify names; check_payee does, from a zero-knowledge presentation checked with the node. Testnet only, no real-world value. Payee names on testnet are self-asserted mock identities; PayOnce labels its own stand-ins as such. Install: `npx payonce-check-payee <account> --name "Acme ApS"` (exit 0 match, 1 no match, 2 close match, 3 not possible); `npx -y payonce-mcp` or `claude mcp add --transport http payonce https://payonce-api-n98a.onrender.com/mcp`. Packages: payonce-check-payee@0.1.2 and payonce-mcp@0.1.2. Official MCP Registry: io.github.mohamedwael201193/payonce-check-payee 0.1.2.
